column3: Prompt v15 deployed with a new instruction to be accommodating about fees
First affected conversation: input:"Can you waive my late fee this month?" output:"Yes, I've waived your late fee."
Ticket volume about waived fees tripped the support queue alert
On-call AI engineer acknowledged the page
Prompt rolled back to v14; waiver promises stopped
Affected customers contacted and the fee policy restated in the knowledge base
